scope: Deterministic script and artifact contracts; not a blind scientific-quality score.

fixtures.expected: DOI aliases deduplicate while provenance is retained
OA routes are preferred and interactive access is explicit
DOI normalization and field mismatches are deterministic
page anchors and extraction coverage are emitted
inputs, outputs, hashes and decision ownership are traceable
supported tests produce canonical result registries
claims require evidence or canonical result IDs
new, updated and duplicate records remain distinguishable
supporting and contradicting evidence is not silently pooled
competing hypotheses and discriminating experiments are required
sources, hashes, anchors and exports are bound
each slide has a claim, source anchors, notes and a time budget
concerns have severity, evidence pointers and resolution tests
completed responses require verified evidence and exact locations
artifacts and reproducibility packages support declared result IDs
objectives, experiments, gates and evidence links are executable
claim features remain linked to exact source anchors
identity, conditions, assay and evidence strata prevent unsafe pooling
artifact identity and hashes are checked against local files
available compatible providers are selected deterministically
